Current deliverable scope — reorganization approved 25 October 2026

Outcome: The reviewed course submissions, final demonstration/evidence archive and handover are recorded, with submission receipts where applicable.

SO101-71 becomes standalone final defect-closure/reproduction acceptance. Actual fixes remain with their owning technical epic; link fixes to this acceptance record rather than duplicate implementation.

Planning alias A6. Existing task keys, dates, owners, workflow states and sprint memberships are preserved. Earlier workstream descriptions below are historical context where they extend beyond this bounded outcome; follow the reassigned child tasks for current execution ownership.

Start: 2026-09-13. Due: 2026-12-06. Dates are in Asia/Bangkok; an internal due date is a delivery handoff, not evidence of completion. The user authorized applying version 3 to Jira.

Semester 1 management envelope; project continues in the separate Semester 2 proposal.

Project A dates and adopted scope

Fixed deliverables: EDA 16 October 2026; three-model baseline report 24 October; Project Plan 25 October; nine-profile conversion report 14 November; Sprint 1 course package 15 November; Project A final 6 December. Individual research reports due 11 October are user-confirmed complete for the original roster (historical completion). Reviews remain 8 and 29 November. Project B starts 11 January 2027; its university deadline is unknown.

Deliver actual VENTUNO Q and simulation evidence for all nine selected-model/precision profiles. Project A delivers the simulation benchmark, nine VENTUNO Q profiles, reports and minimum experiment console. The printed-arm branch and its procurement, assembly and physical-trial gates were removed by the user on 21 October 2026. Project A no longer waits for a 30 November arm-availability decision. Commercial-arm work remains a separate, conditional Project B activity.

Requirements and source context

Coordinate the academic research project: robot-arm performance experiments, reproducible comparisons, team decisions, risks, integration, and reporting.

Confirmed team

  • AI: Duc (lead), Hoan.

  • SoftDev: Khanh (lead), Trieu.

  • IoT: Chung (sole Project A member).

  • Hoan also owns PM, integration coordination, and report writing.

  • All remaining Project A IoT tasks are owned by Chung following the user update on 21 October 2026.

Confirmed schedule

  • Sprint 1 starts on 10 October 2026 and ends on 15 November 2026. Review/meeting: 8 November 2026.

  • Pre-Sprint intentionally overlaps Sprint 1. Its recorded dates are 13 September to 24 October 2026 at 00:00 (UTC+7).

All unresolved fields and proposals in the Word plan become decision tasks. Record decisions, evidence, owner/approver, and scope/schedule effects before treating a proposal as a commitment. Estimates and unapproved performance targets remain unset.

Record task success, execution speed, model inference speed, and resource use with explicit measurement definitions. VENTUNO Q is available. A commercial arm is being ordered and may arrive in February 2027; arrival is unconfirmed. Printed-arm production and its dependent physical work have been removed from Project A.
